diagnostics.message: google_tags_tag_binding.binding binds a TagValue to the organization, but its tag_value is resolved from an opaque string (var.tag_bindings / local.ctx.tag_values) and therefore establishes no dependency edge. The module itself creates tag values via google_tags_tag_value.default, and a tag binding cannot be created until the referenced TagValue exists. Add depends_on = [google_tags_tag_value.default] so bindings are created only after the module-managed tag values.
